CUET UG 2026 Results Announced by NTA

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the results for the CUET UG 2026 examination. Over 15.68 lakh candidates registered for the test, which determines undergraduate admissions for the 2026-27 academic session. Candidates can now download their scorecards from the official NTA website. Some reports indicate that 22 students achieved 100 percentile scores in three subjects.
